title: Opening hours from an enum switch

blocks.text: An `enum` makes a switch type-safe: its cases name the constants directly (`case MONDAY:`), and no other value can reach it.

A shop opens `9` hours on weekdays, `5` hours on Saturday and not at all on Sunday. Write `hours(DayOfWeek day)` in `Opening`, using `java.time.DayOfWeek` and a `switch` statement whose cases name the days:

cases.says: Saturday opens 5 hours, not a weekday's 9.

concepts: A switch over an enum names its constants directly and keeps the comparison type-safe.
